stories.title: MetaRoCE：为 AI 规模以太网打造的全新 RDMA 传输协议 / MetaRoCE： A New RDMA Transport Built for AI-Scale Ethernet

sources.title: MetaRoCE：为 AI 规模以太网打造的全新 RDMA 传输协议 / MetaRoCE： A New RDMA Transport Built for AI-Scale Ethernet
sources.title_zh: MetaRoCE：为 AI 规模以太网打造的全新 RDMA 传输协议
sources.title_en: MetaRoCE： A New RDMA Transport Built for AI-Scale Ethernet
sources.title_original: MetaRoCE： A New RDMA Transport Built for AI-Scale Ethernet
sources.summary: Meta 设计并开源了 MetaRoCE，一个专为 AI 工作负载在通用以太网上打造的 RDMA 传输协议，已通过 Open Compute Project（OCP）发布规范、参考软件实现和合规测试套件。该协议将智能移至端点，原生支持乱序交付、多路径、无损容忍和双向拥塞控制，无需 PFC，可在百万 GPU 规模下提供高吞吐、低尾延迟。现有 RDMA Verbs API 和软件栈无需修改即可运行。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: MetaRoCE是Meta面向百万GPU规模以太网设计的新RDMA传输协议，免PFC，用多路径喷洒与256-bit选择性确认，实现高吞吐低尾延迟。

stories.title: 台湾网络安全公司警告称，AI工具使中国国家支持的网络攻击数量增加了一倍以上。 / Taiwanese cybersecurity firm warns that AI tools have more than doubled Chinese state-backed cyberattacks

sources.title: 台湾网络安全公司警告称，AI工具使中国国家支持的网络攻击数量增加了一倍以上。 / Taiwanese cybersecurity firm warns that AI tools have more than doubled Chinese state-backed cyberattacks
sources.title_zh: 台湾网络安全公司警告称，AI工具使中国国家支持的网络攻击数量增加了一倍以上。
sources.title_en: Taiwanese cybersecurity firm warns that AI tools have more than doubled Chinese state-backed cyberattacks
sources.title_original: Taiwanese cybersecurity firm warns that AI tools have more than doubled Chinese state-backed cyberattacks
sources.summary:
Chinese state-backed hacking groups have more than doubled their attacks since they started using AI models like DeepSeek to write exploit code and scan networks, according to Taiwanese security firm TeamT5. Hackers also used ChatGPT and Anthropic's Claude Code. A UK study shows the cyber capabilities of open models are catching up fast.
Chinese state-backed hacking groups have more than doubled their attacks since they started using AI models like DeepSeek to write exploit code and scan network
